items.question: Do you take a cut of food and drink?
items.answer: No. {{brand.name}} charges 5% of ticket sales only, never more than ₹10,000 per billing cycle. What guests spend at the bar is yours.

items.question: We have no one to run the night. Can a host do it?
items.answer: Yes. List your space and we’ll introduce you to hosts as matching starts. Until then, you can invite a host you know to run a night at your venue on {{brand.name}}.

items.question: Can we sell a ticket that includes food or a drink?
items.answer: Yes. Set the price and say what’s included on the page. The kitchen sees the numbers before the night.

items.question: Can promoters be paid on what they bring?
items.answer: Each promoter gets their own link, and {{brand.name}} shows the bookings and revenue from it. How you pay them is up to you.

items.question: We have more than one outlet.
items.answer: Each outlet can have its own page. Ask us for a walkthrough on WhatsApp and we’ll set up the team for you.

items.question: Do guests need an app?
items.answer: No. Guests book, pay and check in on your page in their phone’s browser.
